source.description: A minimal requirements.txt pinning two real, CVE-affected dependency versions. Not a synthetic vulnerability — the CVEs are real and sourced to OSV; the manifest models the common acquisition scenario of inherited vulnerable pins. Scored by the SCA adapter (pip-audit / OSV-Scanner), which is not installed in a bare CI env, so this fixture's score is deferred to a tooled run.

notes: SCA findings anchor to line 1 of the manifest (the adapter's honest 'whole manifest' convention — see sca_adapter.py). severity is the SCA adapter's default (medium). source_lens is omitted so a case matches whether flagged by pip-audit or OSV-Scanner. citation_contains uses the package name, which (with file=requirements.txt) uniquely identifies each pinned advisory.
